evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME pointing at a fresh temp root. Create a new context repo for Acme Robotics. Company: Acme Robotics. Initial person: Maya Chen, Head of Growth. Focus: founder-led outbound to warehouse operators. Public sources: https://example.com/acme-robotics and https://example.com/maya-chen. Confirm the write preview and create the repo.
evals.expected_output: A new git-backed GTM context repo is created under the redirected GTM_HOME with state registration, root org.md, people/maya-chen/person.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .gitignore, and no skill-owned ICP/persona/scoring files.
expectations: Uses the redirected GTM_HOME and does not touch live ~/.gtm
Creates state.json and a context repo folder
Creates org.md, a root person folder/file, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .gitignore
Does not create icps, personas, account-scoring.md, lead-scoring.md, or a default suborg
Reports no remote push or external side effects

evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME seeded from dev/evals/fixtures/gtm-home. Validate the active Google Cloud EMEA context and repair missing or stale setup-owned files if needed. Confirm any repair preview.
evals.expected_output: The fixture repo is validated against the setup contract, with missing setup-only files repaired and downstream skill-owned files preserved.
expectations: Resolves the active project from state.json
Checks root org.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .gitignore, person file, and active org path
Preserves ICP, persona, scoring, and research files
Reports created, preserved, repaired, skipped, and failed steps distinctly

evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME seeded from dev/evals/fixtures/gtm-home. Switch the active project to Acme Robotics as Maya Chen at root and summarize the resolved context without changing durable repo files.
evals.expected_output: The active project/person/org pins are updated through state.json and summarized without rewriting committed context files.
expectations: Resolves project, person, and org path from local state and prompt
Keeps active local state in state.json
Does not modify org.md, AGENTS.md, or skill-owned context
Recommends ICP and persona definition only if they are missing

evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME seeded from dev/evals/fixtures/gtm-home. Add a suborg under google/cloud called nordics for Nordic cloud growth. Confirm the preview and create the suborg.
evals.expected_output: Only suborgs/cloud/suborgs/nordics/org.md is created and local state can pin google/cloud/nordics when requested.
expectations: Resolves google/cloud as the parent org
Previews canonical org path cloud/nordics and physical path
Creates only the new org.md file
Does not create empty collection folders or skill-owned files

evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME pointing at a fresh temp root. Create a new context repo for SafePath Labs, but the requested org id is ../escape and the source links include https://example.com/safepath, https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123?token=secret, and http://localhost:3000/debug. Do not write until the preview proves path safety and source-link handling.
evals.expected_output: The setup flow rejects the path-escaping id, classifies source links before saving, keeps unsafe/private links out of committed context, and waits for corrected safe ids or explicit confirmation before any durable write.
expectations: Rejects or asks to replace the ../escape id before deriving paths
Does not create files outside the canonical repo root
Classifies the public example.com link as saveable after confirmation
Does not commit the tokenized HubSpot URL or localhost URL
Uses safe labels or omission reasons for unsafe/private links
Does not perform a durable write until the path and source-link preview is safe

evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME seeded from dev/evals/fixtures/gtm-home. Register a cloned copy of the Google fixture from a path outside GTM_HOME as Priya Shah, Regional Sales Lead, and pin the registered project to cloud/emea.
evals.expected_output: The cloned repo is validated, state.json receives a separate project entry pointing at the external path, people/priya-shah/person.md is created after preview, and the org/person pins are set.
expectations: Validates root org.md and AGENTS.md before activation
Registers the existing path in place rather than copying it under GTM_HOME
Creates only the missing root person file for Priya Shah
Sets org pin cloud/emea and person pin priya-shah in state.json
Preserves existing suborg, ICP, persona, and scoring files
